newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasury announces first NADBank financing.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasury announces first NADBank financing.

text.p: The Treasury Department said Friday that a bank jointly financed by the U.S. and Mexican governments as part of a North American free trade pact has made its first loans.
The North American Development bank, called NADBank, approved loans and guarantees to help get financing for two water treatment projects along the border.

They include an $830,000 water supply and wastewater treatment plant at Naco, Sonora, and a $1.1 million treatment plant at a private-sector project in Matamoros. NADBank is lending $180,000 to help the Nacos project and offering a 50 percent guarantee to help get commercial financing for the Matamoros project.
